messages:
Mira: Heads-up — Venice customer asked for a dry-run of the private cutover this week. Can we confirm network, installer, and onprem infra are all cleared?
Jules: Network progress: subnets and SGs in place. Still need Venice to validate their proxy NAT+egress rules. I raised a question about X-Forwarded-For passthrough to their infra team.
Sam: Infra: found a recurring nvme I/O tail issue in canary perf runs. Thinking we should flip the scheduler to mq-deadline and bump io_uring kernel param. I can stage the kernel change in test pool but need Eng-SRE approval before prod.
Rachel: Eng-SRE here. Drop the kernel change RFC and a short perf log snippet. I'll run through it tomorrow AM. Do we have stable smoke VMs?
Sam: RFC: https://internal.redwood/patches/venice-io-sched-rfc — contains perf graphs. Smoke VMs passed basic throughput tests but we haven't run long-tail 6h soak yet.
Mira: @Abby-CS can you confirm Venice signed off on the offline bundle verification? we need the checklist for our air-gapped onboarding.
Abby-CS: Customer update: checksum + signature verified last night. Their Sec team still reviewing HSM/KMS notes; they expect to approve by EOD local time. I'll upload the signed checklist here once complete.
Dave: DevEx: installer-image bump is blocked by my bootstrap script PR. I left comments on entitlements and subnet handling. @Jules ping for quick review — it's the last blocker for the new image.
Jules: Noted — will review in ~20m. Also added a comment: bootstrap should accept dual-subnet REDWOOD_VPC_CIDR arrays for HA.
deploy-bot: [schedule] Canary window requested: 2026-03-19 02:00-03:30 UTC. Runbook draft: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/venice-private-dryrun
Mira: Proposal for owners for the canary checklist: Network = Jules, Infra = Sam, Installer/DevEx = Dave, Customer liaison = Abby-CS, Rollback lead = Rachel. Agree?
Rachel: I can take rollback. Will prepare a pre-canary rollback dry-run section and confirm rollback smoke steps. Need a stub in the runbook before we start.
Abby-CS: I'll chase Venice Sec and HSM lead. If they finish signoff today I can post the signed artifact + contact for emergency egress exceptions.
Sam: After Eng-SRE OK, I'll apply the kernel tweak to the staging node pool and run the long-tail soak. I'll mark infra ready once soak passes 6h.
Dave: I'll incorporate the dual-subnet bootstrap change after Jules LGTM, then cut the installer image and attach install smoke logs to the runbook.
Jules: LGTM posted on bootstrap PR and addressed the REDWOOD_VPC_CIDR handling. Network green except for customer's proxy egress confirmation.
Mira: Thanks. Next async check-in in 12h unless we get blockers. If anything blocks the dry-run, @channel tag with `venice-dryrun-blocker`. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: [note] Incident auto-link created if rollback is triggered: I-20260319-venice-canary
